items.question: How is exact age in years, months, and days calculated?
items.answer: Age calculation determines the full calendar months between dates, adjusts for end-of-month day boundaries, and adds the remaining calendar days between the intermediate anchor date and the target date.

items.question: How are February 29 leap day birthdays handled in common years?
items.answer: For individuals born on February 29 (leap day), standard international demographic convention recognizes their birthday as February 28 during non-leap years. This tool adheres strictly to that rule.

items.question: Why does this tool prevent date shifts across time zones?
items.answer: Many online date utilities convert date inputs into UTC strings, causing birth dates to shift by a day depending on your local time zone. Our tool parses dates as discrete calendar integers `{year, month, day}` to eliminate time zone offsets.

items.question: Can I calculate my age at a future or historical date?
items.answer: Yes. Simply adjust the "Age At Date" field to any date on or after your birth date to see your exact age at that historical milestone or future anniversary.

items.question: How does the tool determine what day of the week I was born on?
items.answer: The day of the week is determined using the Gregorian calendar cycle via UTC day-of-week indexing, ensuring accurate identification (such as Monday or Saturday) regardless of your current time zone.

items.question: How are total days and total weeks counted?
items.answer: Total days represent the exact elapsed astronomical days between dates (`Date.UTC`), accounting for every leap year in the intervening period. Total weeks are calculated by integer division of total days by 7.

items.question: Is my birth date uploaded or stored anywhere?
items.answer: No. All date calculations run 100% locally in your browser. No birth dates, target dates, or calculation outputs are transmitted to our servers or stored in any database.

items.question: How does the countdown to my next birthday work?
items.answer: The calculator checks whether your birthday has already occurred in the current target year. If it has, it counts down the days to your birthday in the subsequent year; otherwise, it counts down to your birthday this year.

items.question: What happens if the target date is earlier than the birth date?
items.answer: The tool strictly rejects target dates that precede your birth date, displaying an inline validation message and showing no results until a valid chronological pair is entered.
